title: A set that coincides near x with the affine plane x + V has approximate tangent space V at x (Simon Ch. 3, 1.4; used for the open faces in step 6 of the parent proof)
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, N ⊆ ℝ^P (Euclid P), x ∈ ℝ^P, V a linear subspace of ℝ^P with dim V = n (Module.finrank ℝ V = n), and r > 0 such that for every y with |y − x| < r: y ∈ N if and only if y − x ∈ V. Then N has approximate tangent space V at x (HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n N x V, Simon Ch. 3, 1.4: dim V = n and ∫_{blowUpMap x λ '' N} f dHⁿ → ∫_V f dHⁿ as λ ↓ 0 for every f ∈ C_c(ℝ^P), where blowUpMap x λ y = λ⁻¹(y − x) and Hⁿ = μHE[n]).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (N : Set (Euclid P)) (x : Euclid P) (V : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (r : ℝ), Module.finrank ℝ V = n → 0 < r → (∀ y ∈ Metric.ball x r, y ∈ N ↔ y - x ∈ V) → HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n N x V
